exposure: Change in cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) after 30 weeks' gestation
cohort: 1860 women with at least two ultrasound scans between 30 and 37 weeks' gestation
finding: While both individual CPR Z-score and the change in CPR Z-score can identify pregnancies at risk of adverse outcomes, the CPR Z-score at 35-37 weeks' gestation is a better predictor.
mod_finding: An increase in CPR Z-score over time was associated with a lower risk for emergency Cesarean delivery.
